label: PF Backlog 148
title: Run/attempt linkage + preserve-first resume reconciliation (no data clearing)
body:
New core/run_state.py — pipeline-runs.json registry (run_id, resumed_from, stopped_run, stages_completed); run_id stamped on approval records; reconcile() marks stages that already have a fully-approved approval set + artifacts as completed so resume SKIPS done work and NEVER clears user-entered data. Wired into scripts/run_pipeline.py.

RUN-ID (single mint + stamping, done): new_run_id()/norm_run_id() in pipeline_executor is the ONE mint point (canonical 'run-<epoch>'; pipeline-<epoch> accepted via norm_run_id). Run id is now STAMPED on: approvals (pipeline_executor._create_approval_request), audit entries (audit_trail.AuditTrail.log_action + current_run_id()), artifact metadata (artifact_store.create_or_update_artifact metadata.run_id), and the run registry (run_state.pipeline-runs.json). Back-fill stamps a provable run window else 'legacy' (never guesses); annotate_run() gives read-side 'run X'/'legacy'; check_live_action() strictly validates an action's run_id against the live lock. Wired into scripts/run_pipeline.py (backfill + reconcile before execute).

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend/infra change; dashboard reads the new index as data only.

_note: Implemented core/run_state.py: pipeline-runs.json registry (run_id/resumed_from/stopped_run/stages_completed); run_id stamped on approval records (pipeline_executor._create_approval_request); reconcile() marks already-approved+built stages completed so resume SKIPS them; NEVER clears user data. Wired into scripts/run_pipeline.py.
